title: Cute pattern, but there is no adhesion
text: Cute pattern, but there is no adhesion. I tried to use this in my pantry where I keep my larger appliances like my KitchenAid mixer. But because there’s no adhesion, the liner comes up every time I take my mixer in and out of the pantry. So these are probably better used in an area that something is permanently sitting on.
